ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity (black) central surface and high-intensity (white) distal lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs located on the lateral extremities of both lobes. The left lobe distal region contains a broad white patch with scattered low-intensity circular points. The central-medial region is a solid low-intensity black block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an estimated vertex angle of 40-50 degrees, partially occluded at the base by the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with irregular pixel-amplitude (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, most pronounced on the upward-tilted left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the leading edges of the lobes as they sweep from the central submerged axis toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed within the high-intensity white zones of the fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, high-intensity linear marks (diagonal and vertical scratches) detected against the low-intensity black surface of the central fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged morphology at the distal-most tips of both lobes, suggesting significant wear or barnacle-related scarring.
